pre_condition: work_dir is a string path to a directory that may contain the subdirectory spec_prompts/domain_context/ with files named phase_NN_types.txt where NN is a zero-padded two-digit integer. removed_phase_nums is a list where each element is either an integer phase number or None. renumbered is a dict mapping integer old phase numbers to integer new phase numbers.
post_condition: If work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/ does not exist as a directory, the function returns immediately with no filesystem modifications. Otherwise: for every non-None integer n in removed_phase_nums, the file phase_{n:02d}_types.txt under domain_context/ is deleted if it existed — if absent, the deletion is silently skipped. For every (old_num, new_num) in renumbered where old_num == new_num, the file phase_{old_num:02d}_types.txt is left unmodified. For every (old_num, new_num) in renumbered where old_num != new_num: if phase_{old_num:02d}_types.txt exists, it is renamed to phase_{new_num:02d}_types.txt with the same content; if absent, the rename is silently skipped. Renames are applied such that when two renames form a chain (e.g., old A maps to new B and old B maps to new C), no file content is overwritten or lost — the original content from each distinct pre-existing source file is preserved at its final destination. Files for phase numbers not appearing in removed_phase_nums and mapping to themselves in renumbered are unmodified.
